method: Two plans written by hand. The calendar lists each event's obligations with the same scope and method as the event test set. Budget totals are plain sums of whole-cent amounts. Problems were identified by reading the USG guidelines and web page, the Student Handbook and the Trojan Event Services pages against each plan.

cases.purpose: Undergraduate cultural club planning Spring 2027: the demo story.

club.name: Lantern Cultural Society
club.mission: Share East and Southeast Asian lantern traditions with the USC community.

problems.note: Five events ask USG for money; the web page says 4 per semester (not in the guidelines).
USG requests total $11,250.00, over the $8,000.00 yearly cap by $3,250.00.

Counted back nine calendar weeks from February 26, 2027 the travel deadline is December 25, 2026 (winter recess); the transcribed USG deadline table (unverified) gives Wednesday, November 18, 2026, three days after the as-of date. Either way it falls before the spring semester.

Counted back six calendar weeks from February 5, 2027 the deadline is December 25, 2026 (winter recess); the transcribed USG deadline table (unverified) gives Wednesday, November 18, 2026. Either way it falls before the spring semester.

cases.purpose: Undergraduate professional club: same-day requests, alcohol on a Wednesday, cash sponsor, finals week, yearly cap.

club.name: Quant Careers Circle
club.mission: Help undergraduates prepare for careers in data science and quantitative finance.

problems.note: Five events ask USG for money; the web page says 4 per semester (not in the guidelines).
Corporate sponsorship may only be in kind.
May 5, 2027 is during final exams; USG does not fund events during finals.
Already received $5,000.00; requests of $5,300.00 make $10,300.00, over by $2,300.00.

Counted back six calendar weeks the deadline is December 23, 2026 (winter recess); the transcribed USG deadline table (unverified) gives Wednesday, November 18, 2026. Either way it falls before the spring semester.
